title: The Manhunt, the Manifesto and the Murder Charge

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在早上4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最棒的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢一锅端的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，助您理解世界，充分过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，即可在 nytimes.com 连斜杠 subscribe 获取特惠。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The five-day manhunt for the killer of a healthcare CEO.
sentences.zh: 针对一名医疗集团首席执行官凶手的为期五天的搜捕行动。

sentences.en: What we know about the suspect now in custody.
sentences.zh: 我们对目前被拘留的嫌疑人有何了解。

sentences.en: And what the case has revealed about many Americans' contempt for insurance companies.
sentences.zh: 以及该案揭示了许多美国人对保险公司的鄙视。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, December 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月10日星期二。

sentences.en: On Wednesday morning of last week, the chief executive of United Healthcare, Brian Thompson,
sentences.zh: 上周三早晨，联合健康集团首席执行官布莱恩·汤普森

sentences.en: left his hotel in Midtown Manhattan for his company's investor conference a few blocks away.
sentences.zh: 离开他在曼哈顿中城的酒店，前往几个街区外的公司投资者会议。

sentences.en: It was 6.45 in the morning, still mostly dark out.
sentences.zh: 当时是早上6点45分，外面大部分地方仍然很黑。

sentences.en: And as Thompson neared his destination, a hooded and masked gunman emerged from behind a parked car,
sentences.zh: 正当汤普森接近目的地时，一名戴着连帽衫和口罩的枪手从一辆停着的汽车后面闪出，

sentences.en: took out a gun with a silencer, and began to fire at him over and over in what's clearly a targeted attack.
sentences.zh: 掏出一把带消音器的枪，在显然是有目标的袭击中一次又一次地向他开枪。

sentences.en: Chilling new details tonight, following what police say was the premeditated murder of the CEO of United Healthcare on the busy streets of Midtown Manhattan early today.
sentences.zh: 今晚有令人不寒而栗的新细节，在此前警方所说的心狠手辣谋杀案发生后，受害者是联合健康集团首席执行官，案发于今天早晨曼哈顿中城繁忙的街道上。

sentences.en: Surveillance videos of all of this, which emerged a few hours later, shocked the city.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后曝光的所有这些监控视频震惊了整个城市。

sentences.en: It was so surreal.
sentences.zh: 这太超现实了。

sentences.en: It's something that you would watch on a TV show or in a movie, this like in cold blood assassination, two blocks away from my house.
sentences.zh: 这就像你在电视剧或电影里看到的那种冷血谋杀，就发生在离我家两个街区的地方。

sentences.en: What I heard was that he ran up 6th Avenue and into the park.
sentences.zh: 我听到的是他沿着第六大道跑进了公园。

sentences.en: And so, you know, that would be like right here.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，那就像是在这里。

sentences.en: And just as shocking was how effortlessly Thompson's killer got away.
sentences.zh: 同样令人震惊的是，汤普森的凶手逃脱得如此毫不费力。

sentences.en: According to the NYPD, the shooter took off through an alley, grabbing an e-bike and riding it into Central Park, which at that time was filled with morning runners and walkers.
sentences.zh: 据纽约市警察局称，枪手穿过一条小巷，抓起一辆电单车，骑着它进入了中央公园，当时公园里挤满了晨跑和散步的人。

sentences.en: By the end of the day, a massive citywide manhunt was underway.
sentences.zh: 到了一天结束时，一场全城范围内的大规模搜捕行动正在进行。

sentences.en: Cops literally fan out across Central Park.
sentences.zh: 警察 буквально 遍布了整个中央公园。

sentences.en: Hotel rooms are being searched.
sentences.zh: 酒店房间正在被搜查。

sentences.en: Drones are put in the air.
sentences.zh: 无人机被放飞到空中。

sentences.en: New this morning, NYPD releasing surveillance photos of the suspected gunman at a New York hostel without a mask.
sentences.zh: 今天早晨的新消息，纽约市警察局发布了嫌疑枪手在纽约一家旅馆里未戴口罩的监控照片。

sentences.en: Eventually, small pieces of evidence emerge.
sentences.zh: 最终，细小的证据浮出水面。

sentences.en: A major discovery.
sentences.zh: 一个重大发现。

sentences.en: Police sources say they found a backpack believed to be the shooter's.
sentences.zh: 警方消息人士称，他们找到了一个被认为是枪手所有的双肩背包。

sentences.en: No gun was found inside.
sentences.zh: 里面没有发现枪支。

sentences.en: What was found?
sentences.zh: 发现了什么？

sentences.en: A jacket and Monopoly money.
sentences.zh: 一件夹克和大富翁钞票。

sentences.en: And as speculation begins about why exactly this CEO was targeted, the question naturally arises.
sentences.zh: 正当人们开始猜测这位首席执行官究竟为何成为目标时，问题自然而然地产生了。

sentences.en: Was this about health care?
sentences.zh: 这与医疗保健有关吗？

sentences.en: And the police reveal a single piece of evidence that suggests perhaps it was.
sentences.zh: 警察透露了一个单一的证据，表明可能确实如此。

sentences.en: The words delay, deny, and possibly depose were written on shell casings recovered from the scene.
sentences.zh: 从现场回收的弹壳上写着“拖延”、“拒绝”和“可能罢免”这几个字。

sentences.en: Those words are strikingly similar to a title of a book that condemns the insurance business.
sentences.zh: 这些字眼惊人地相似于一本谴责保险行业的书的书名。

sentences.en: Suddenly, it looks like this murderer and this missing suspect have tapped into something much bigger.
sentences.zh: 突然间，看起来这个凶手和这个在逃的嫌疑人已经触及了某种大得多的东西。

sentences.en: I mean, every person in America has had a brush with the health care system that has not been, you know, excellent.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，美国每一个人都曾与医疗系统有过接触，而那种体验说不上有多好。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Dionne Cerce, who writes about wealth and power in New York.
sentences.zh: 我采访了我的同事迪昂·瑟斯，她负责报道纽约的财富与权力。

sentences.en: I got brought into this story last week, the day after the shooting, when I had noticed a lot of posts on social media strangely in support of the shooter.
sentences.zh: 我上周被卷入这个故事，就在枪击事件发生的第二天，当时我注意到社交媒体上有大量帖子莫名其妙地支持枪手。

sentences.en: You know, some of the posts were very pointed and direct and just full of malice for the victim, which is something that we don't usually see.
sentences.zh: 你知道，其中一些帖子非常尖锐直接，充满了对受害者的恶意，这是我们平时不常见的。

sentences.en: So I just started going through tweets and going through all the networks and collecting just this kind of outrage over the health care system.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始浏览推特，浏览所有的网络，收集这种对医疗系统的愤怒情绪。

sentences.en: Let me just start off this video by saying I do not condone violence by any means.
sentences.zh: 让我在这段视频开头先说一句，我绝不容忍任何形式的暴力。

sentences.en: But let's talk about what happened today with the UnitedHealthcare CEO.
sentences.zh: 但让我们来谈谈今天联合健康集团首席执行官身上发生的事情。

sentences.en: Six months before my mom died, her health insurance let her know that all of the things that she had been prescribed and insured for for the last 10,
sentences.zh: 在我妈妈去世前六个月，她的医疗保险通知她，在过去10年、

sentences.en: 15 years of her life were no longer going to be covered.
sentences.zh: 15年里她被开具处方并一直承保的所有项目，将不再予以报销。

sentences.en: There was some real anger that this unleashed.
sentences.zh: 这释放出了一种真正的愤怒。

sentences.en: Sitting in the emergency room with my one-year-old baby.
sentences.zh: 带着我一岁的宝宝坐在急诊室里。

sentences.en: She needed to be transferred to New York City so she could have emergency brain surgery.
sentences.zh: 她需要被转院到纽约市以便接受紧急脑部手术。

sentences.en: And instead, we sat in the hospital for three days because UnitedHealthcare refused to approve the transfer via ambulance.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们在医院里坐了三天，因为联合健康集团拒绝批准通过救护车转院。

sentences.en: You know, moms who couldn't get an ambulance ride covered.
sentences.zh: 你知道，妈妈们无法获得救护车费用的报销。

sentences.en: So my UnitedHealthcare story is that when my son needed a special type of bed because of his disability, they denied us that.
sentences.zh: 所以我的联合健康集团的故事是，当我儿子因为残疾需要一张特殊类型的床时，他们拒绝了我们的申请。

sentences.en: Today is a beautifully ironic day for UnitedHealthcare to deny my injections for my cancer treatments.
sentences.zh: 对于联合健康集团来说，今天是充满绝妙讽刺意味的一天，他们拒绝支付我癌症治疗的注射费用。

sentences.en: There's no shortage of really painful experiences.
sentences.zh: 痛苦的经历多得数不清。

sentences.en: And I think why emotions are so heightened is because you interact with health insurance companies at obviously some of the worst moments of your life.
sentences.zh: 我想之所以情绪如此高涨，是因为你显然是在你生命中最糟糕的一些时刻与健康保险公司打交道。

sentences.en: When your kid is hurting or dying, when you are hurting or dying.
sentences.zh: 当你的孩子受伤或垂死时，当你自己受伤或垂死时。

sentences.en: I mean, you're keyed up for some pretty charged emotions.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你已经做好了产生相当大情绪波动的准备。

sentences.en: You know, maybe violence is not the way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，也许暴力并不是解决之道。

sentences.en: But have you read any of the comments on those videos reporting this story?
sentences.zh: 但你读过报道这个故事的那些视频底下的任何评论吗？

sentences.en: People are calloused.
sentences.zh: 人们已经变得冷酷无情。

sentences.en: People do not care because the health insurance companies do not care about their lives.
sentences.zh: 人们根本不在乎，因为健康保险公司根本不在乎他们的生命。

sentences.en: Plenty of people are not celebrating what happened here.
sentences.zh: 许多人并不是在庆祝这里发生的事情。

sentences.en: They're just seeing it as a chance to...
sentences.zh: 他们只是把它看作是一个……的机会。

sentences.en: Event.
sentences.zh: 发泄。

sentences.en: Yeah, to fume about it.
sentences.zh: 对，借此发泄一番。

sentences.en: Yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, medical debt is insane right now in America.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现在美国的医疗债务简直疯狂。

sentences.en: And here's a guy who found a path, you know, to do something about it in the worst possible way.
sentences.zh: 而这里有个人找到了一条途径，你知道的，用最糟糕的可能方式对此采取了行动。

sentences.en: And then on Monday morning, five days into this manhunt and this growing expression of fury at the U.S.
sentences.zh: 然后在周一早晨，在这场历时五天的搜捕行动以及对美国医疗系统日益高涨的愤怒情绪中，

sentences.en: healthcare system, there's a major development in the story.
sentences.zh: 这个故事有了重大进展。

sentences.en: So I came this morning to the shack just to get a sense of the buzz.
sentences.zh: 所以我今天早晨来到这个临时办公室，只是为了感受一下坊间的议论。

sentences.en: I wasn't expecting that there would be a break in the case.
sentences.zh: 我没料到案情会有所突破。

sentences.en: So I called my colleague, police reporter Maria Kramer, who works out of a small press room inside the NYPD, called the shack.
sentences.zh: 所以我给我的同事、警察记者玛丽亚·克雷默打了电话，她在纽约市警察局内部一个被称为“临时办公室”的小新闻室里工作。

sentences.en: So I went upstairs, confirmed some tantalizing details, like they'd found Monopoly money in the backpack,
sentences.zh: 所以我上了楼，确认了一些诱人的细节，比如他们在背包里发现了大富翁钞票，

sentences.en: that the canine units that are good at detecting guns had been deployed at close to where the Greyhound Depot was.
sentences.zh: 擅长侦测枪支的警犬队已经被部署在灰狗巴士站附近的地方。

sentences.en: So, you know, we were just going to do sort of a small update.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们本来只是打算做一个类似小更新的报道。

sentences.en: And then just as we were doing all that, boom.
sentences.zh: 然后就在我们做这一切的时候，轰的一声。

sentences.en: It just very quickly developed that a man was taken into custody in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 局势迅速发展，一名男子在宾夕法尼亚州被拘留。

sentences.en: After the break, everything we now know about the suspect.
sentences.zh: 广告之后，我们将带来我们目前对该嫌疑人所了解的一切。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wenna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写“连线”游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的一个拼图项目。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作“拼字蜂”和“连字游戏”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》游戏由真人制作，就像你刚才听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 连斜杠 games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: Maria, this is a fast-moving story, so I just want to acknowledge when we're talking to you.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚，这是一个进展迅速的故事，所以我只想说明我们与你通话的时间。

sentences.en: It's 5.45 or so on Monday night.
sentences.zh: 那是周一晚上5点45分左右。

sentences.en: And I want you to tell us, based on what you know now, how this suspect was caught and how this manhunt came to what looks like its end.
sentences.zh: 我想请你根据你目前所知，告诉我们这个嫌疑人是如何被抓获的，以及这场搜捕行动是如何走向看似尾声的。

sentences.en: And then we'll get to what we're learning about who the suspect is and what truly motivated him.
sentences.zh: 然后我们将讨论我们正在了解到的关于嫌疑人的身份以及他真正的动机是什么。

sentences.en: But let's just start with how he gets caught.
sentences.zh: 但让我们先从他是如何落网的开始讲起。

sentences.en: So what we learn from our police sources and from a news conference where the police address the media...
sentences.zh: 所以我们从警方消息来源以及警方举行的新闻发布会上了解到……

sentences.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: Earlier this morning in Altoona, Pennsylvania...
sentences.zh: 今天早些时候在宾夕法尼亚州阿尔图纳……

sentences.en: That on Monday morning at 9.14 at a McDonald's in Altoona, Pennsylvania...
sentences.zh: 周一上午9点14分，在宾夕法尼亚州阿尔图纳的一家麦当劳里……

sentences.en: The suspect was in a McDonald's and was recognized by an employee...
sentences.zh: 嫌疑人在一家麦当劳里被一名员工认了出来……

sentences.en: You have an employee who notices a man eating in the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 有一名员工注意到一个男子在餐厅里吃东西。

sentences.en: And that employee recognizes this man as the man that was photographed on various surveillance shots
sentences.zh: 而那名员工认出这个男人就是纽约警察局发布的各种监控照片中

sentences.en: released by the New York Police Department as the person of interest in the shooting of Brian Thompson.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩·汤普森枪击案的涉案重点嫌疑人。

sentences.en: He calls 9-1-1, he calls the Altoona Police Department.
sentences.zh: 他拨打了911，拨打了阿尔图纳警察局的电话。

sentences.en: Responding officers question the suspect, who was acting suspiciously and was carrying...
sentences.zh: 出警警员盘问了行为可疑且随身携带……的嫌疑人

sentences.en: They find a man sitting at a table, looking at a laptop and wearing a blue medical mask.
sentences.zh: 他们发现一个男人坐在桌旁，看着一台笔记本电脑，戴着蓝色的医用口罩。

sentences.en: And when an officer asks him to pull down his mask and asks if he's been to New York recently, the man becomes quiet and starts to shake.
sentences.zh: 当一名警官要求他拉下口罩并询问他最近是否去过纽约时，这名男子变得沉默并开始发抖。

sentences.en: Upon further investigation, officers recovered a firearm on his person, as well as a suppressor, both consistent with the weapon used in the murder.
sentences.zh: 经进一步调查，警官在他身上搜出了一支枪以及一个消音器，两者都与谋杀案中使用的武器相符。

sentences.en: Eventually they search him and they find a gun, they find a silencer, and they find fake identification cards.
sentences.zh: 最终他们对其实施搜查，找到了枪支、消音器以及假身份证件。

sentences.en: Also recovered was a fraudulent New Jersey ID, matching the ID our suspect used to check into his New York City hostel before the shooting incident.
sentences.zh: 同时找回的还有一张伪造的新泽西州身份证，与我们嫌疑人在枪击事件发生前用来登记入住纽约市旅馆的身份证相符。

sentences.en: Pretty distinct pieces of evidence, especially the gun and the silencer, that suggest this is most likely their guy.
sentences.zh: 相当独特的证据，尤其是枪支和消音器，表明这很可能就是他们要找的人。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And the gun was a source of much debate online.
sentences.zh: 这把枪在网上引发了大量争论。

sentences.en: People were trying to figure out what this gun was.
sentences.zh: 人们试图弄清楚这到底是一把什么枪。

sentences.en: And what it turns out to be is what we call a ghost gun.
sentences.zh: 结果证明这是我们所说的“幽灵枪”。

sentences.en: You know, these are guns that are assembled from parts that have been printed out from a 3D printer.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这些枪是用3D打印机打印出来的零件组装而成的。

sentences.en: And this gun is capable of firing 9mm rounds, which are the rounds that were found at the crime scene in New York.
sentences.zh: 这把枪能够发射9毫米子弹，这正是纽约犯罪现场发现的子弹型号。

sentences.en: What, Maria, do we begin to learn about this suspect, about who he is, about his biography?
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚，我们开始了解到关于这个嫌疑人的什么信息，他是谁，他的生平背景是怎样的？

sentences.en: So what we learn about this man is that his name is Luigi Mangione.
sentences.zh: 我们对这个男人的了解是，他的名字叫路易吉·曼吉奥尼。

sentences.en: He's 26 years old, and he seems to have come from a life of a lot of privilege.
sentences.zh: 他26岁，似乎出身于一个非常优渥的家庭。

sentences.en: He was born and raised in Maryland.
sentences.zh: 他在马里兰州出生长大。

sentences.en: He went to a private school in Baltimore, the Gilman School.
sentences.zh: 他曾在巴尔的摩的一所私立学校吉尔曼学校就读。

sentences.en: He was a wrestler there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里是一名摔跤手。

sentences.en: He graduated as valedictorian.
sentences.zh: 他以毕业生代表的身份毕业。

sentences.en: He goes on to have an Ivy League background, getting his undergrad degree and his graduate degree at the University of Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 随后他拥有常春藤盟校背景，在宾夕法尼亚大学获得了本科和研究生学位。

sentences.en: And from there, he starts working in tech.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，他开始从事科技行业。

sentences.en: Travels a little bit around the country, living in San Francisco and in Honolulu.
sentences.zh: 在全国各地旅行了一段时间，曾在旧金山和檀香山居住过。

sentences.en: And he has a pretty interesting online presence.
sentences.zh: 他有着相当有趣的在线活动轨迹。

sentences.en: It suggests he's really well read.
sentences.zh: 这表明他博览群书。

sentences.en: He's posting about books that he's read on Goodreads.
sentences.zh: 他在 Goodreads 上发布关于他读过的书的动态。

sentences.en: And by all accounts, if you look at his background, he seems accomplished, but normal.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，如果你看看他的背景，他似乎很有成就，但也很正常。

sentences.en: And according to the police, from what they have learned so far about him, he doesn't have a criminal record.
sentences.zh: 据警方称，从他们目前对他的了解来看，他没有犯罪记录。

sentences.en: There was one citation for him trespassing in Honolulu at a state park.
sentences.zh: 他曾在檀香山的一个州立公园因非法入侵收到过一张传票。

sentences.en: But other than that, his record is clean, at least according to what we know so far.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，他的履历是干净的，至少根据我们目前的了解是这样的。

sentences.en: So what are we learning about how he goes from having no criminal record and having this fairly normal existence to, allegedly, committing murder?
sentences.zh: 那么我们正在了解他是如何从一个没有犯罪记录、过着相当正常生活的人，变成据称犯下谋杀罪的人的呢？

sentences.en: What are the police uncovering about any motivations?
sentences.zh: 警方在动机方面查明了哪些情况？

sentences.en: So there's very little that we know about him personally to suggest that he was going to go from valedictorian of his high school class and UPenn grad to the alleged killer of an executive in New York.
sentences.zh: 关于他个人的情况，我们知之甚少，很难看出他怎么会从高中毕业生代表、宾大毕业生变成纽约一名高管的涉嫌谋杀犯。

sentences.en: But there are some clues that the police are looking at.
sentences.zh: 但警方正在调查一些线索。

sentences.en: And one of the big ones is this three-page handwritten manifesto that the police find on Luigi Mangione when he's arrested.
sentences.zh: 其中最重大的线索之一，就是警方在路易吉·曼吉奥内被捕时从他身上找到的一份三页手写宣言。

sentences.en: And what is in that manifesto, as best we know?
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，那份宣言里写了些什么？

sentences.en: So in this 260-word handwritten manifesto, Luigi Mangione is appearing to take responsibility for the murder, according to a senior law enforcement official who saw the document.
sentences.zh: 据一位看过这份文件的资深执法官员透露，在这份260字的手写宣言中，路易吉·曼吉奥内似乎在为这起谋杀承担责任。

sentences.en: And he notes UnitedHealthcare's market capitalization growing and condemns companies like UnitedHealthcare that, quote, continue to abuse our country for immense profit.
sentences.zh: 他指出了联合健康集团不断增长的市值，并谴责联合健康等公司“继续为了巨额利润而虐待我们的国家”。

sentences.en: And he also, in a pretty haunting part of the document, he says, quote, these parasites had it coming.
sentences.zh: 在文件一个相当令人心酸的部分，他还说道：“这些寄生虫罪有应得。”

sentences.en: And, quote, I do apologize for any strife and trauma, but it had to be done.
sentences.zh: 还有，“我为造成的任何纷争和创伤道歉，但这是不得不做的事。”

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Do we know if he himself personally had a bad experience with UnitedHealthcare?
sentences.zh: 我们知道他本人是否曾与联合健康集团有过糟糕的经历吗？

sentences.en: We don't know if he had a personal experience with the insurance company,
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他是否与这家保险公司有过个人接触，

sentences.en: but we do know that he had been in regular contact with his friends and his family until about six months ago.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道，直到大约六个月前，他一直与朋友和家人保持着定期联系。

sentences.en: That's when he suddenly stopped communicating with them.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他突然停止与他们联系。

sentences.en: And his friends have told us that he had been suffering from a painful back injury at the time.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友告诉我们，当时他正饱受痛苦的背部伤痛折磨。

sentences.en: And that's when communication went dark and his relatives and friends began to become very anxious about him.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，通讯中断了，他的亲友开始对他感到非常焦虑。

sentences.en: Why hadn't anyone heard from him?
sentences.zh: 为什么一直没有人听到他的消息？

sentences.en: The other thing we know is that in the last year, he had been writing many reviews on Goodreads, specifically one about a book that was written by Ted Kaczynski,
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的另一件事是，在过去的一年里，他在古德里兹网站上写了许多书评，其中一篇专门评论了一本书，作者是泰德·卡钦斯基，

sentences.en: the Unabomber who mailed bombs to people that he felt were destroying the world with technology.
sentences.zh: 也就是“大学炸弹客”，他曾把炸弹寄给那些他认为在用技术毁灭世界的人。

sentences.en: Ted Kaczynski killed three people and he was seen he was a terroriSt.
sentences.zh: 泰德·卡钦斯基杀害了三人，他被视为一名恐怖分子。

sentences.en: But in his review, Mr. Mangione describes him as a mathematics prodigy and he tells readers not to dismiss the book as the manifesto of a lunatic.
sentences.zh: 但在书评中，曼吉奥内先生将他描述为一个数学奇才，并告诉读者不要把这本书当成一个疯子的宣言。

sentences.en: He praises him by saying that many of his predictions about modern society turned out to be true.
sentences.zh: 他赞扬说，他关于现代社会的许多预测后来都被证实是真的。

sentences.en: So he was prescient.
sentences.zh: 所以他很有先见之明。

sentences.en: And he specifically says that while he was a violent individual, rightfully imprisoned for killing and maiming people, these actions, and this is a direct quote,
sentences.zh: 他特别指出，虽然他是一个暴力分子，因杀害和残害他人而受到应有的监禁，但这些行为——这是一句直接引语——

sentences.en: while these actions tend to be characterized as those of a crazy Luddite, however, they are more accurately seen as those of an extreme political revolutionary.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些行为往往被定性为疯狂勒德分子的行为，但更准确地说，它们是极端的政治革命者的行为。

sentences.en: So there's admiration in that review of a man who did terribly violent things.
sentences.zh: 因此，在那篇评论中，对一个犯下极其暴力罪行的人充满了赞赏。

sentences.en: To some degree, in the name of stopping corporations from hurting the world.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这是以阻止企业伤害世界为名。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So the working theory here would seem to be that Mangione, over some period of time since he left college,
sentences.zh: 所以目前的初步推测似乎是，自大学毕业以来的某个时期，曼吉奥内

sentences.en: became somebody who identified with these efforts to take on corporate America, perhaps specifically the healthcare industry, out of some belief, allegedly,
sentences.zh: 变成了一个认同这些挑战美国企业界、特别是医疗保健行业努力的人，据称是出于某种信念，

sentences.en: that like the Unabomber, he could single-handedly hold them to account.
sentences.zh: 即像“大学炸弹客”一样，他可以凭一己之力让这些企业承担责任。

sentences.en: At this point, that is a theory that many people hold, but we really don't know what happened to Luigi Mangione.
sentences.zh: 就目前而言，这是许多人持有的理论，但我们确实不知道路易吉·曼吉奥内究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: What awaits Mangione now in the legal system, assuming that police in New York line all this evidence up and decide that he is their suspect in the murder of Brian Thompson?
sentences.zh: 假设纽约警方整理好所有证据，并决定他是杀害布赖恩·汤普森的嫌疑人，曼吉奥内接下来将在法律系统地面临什么？

sentences.en: So just a few minutes ago, Luigi Mangione arrived at the Blair County Courthouse in Hollidaysburg, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 就在几分钟前，路易吉·曼吉奥内抵达了宾夕法尼亚州霍利斯堡的布莱尔县法院。

sentences.en: He was led out of the car by two officers who walked him in, his hands bound behind his back, and there was a huge media presence there.
sentences.zh: 他在两名警官的押解下走出了轿车，双手被反绑在身后，现场有大批媒体聚集。

sentences.en: Here he is being brought into a courthouse, not to face murder charges, but to face gun charges.
sentences.zh: 他被带进法院，不是为了面临谋杀指控，而是为了面临枪支指控。

sentences.en: He's there for preliminary arraignment, and then what's going to happen is prosecutors there will decide whether they want to carry out these charges against him in Pennsylvania,
sentences.zh: 他到那里是为了进行初步提审，接下来，那里的检察官将决定是否要在宾夕法尼亚州对这些指控对他提起诉讼，

sentences.en: or if he can be extradited to New York for presumably, potentially, murder charges for the killing of Brian Thompson.
sentences.zh: 或者他是否可以被引渡到纽约，以面临推测中、潜在的谋杀布赖恩·汤普森的指控。

sentences.en: So, Maria, stepping back just a little bit, I'm curious at this point how you're thinking about this overall case and the meanings that it's taken on.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚，退一步讲，我很好奇你目前如何看待这个整体案件以及它所承载的意义。

sentences.en: We spoke earlier today with our colleague Dion Cersei about just how much this case, before there was a named person of interest, before there was an arrest,
sentences.zh: 我们今天早些时候与同事迪昂·塞尔西谈过，在甚至还没有锁定重点关注对象、还没有实施逮捕之前，这个案件就已经在很大程度上

sentences.en: has become about America's healthcare system and people's frustration with it.
sentences.zh: 演变成了一场关于美国医疗系统以及人们对该系统挫败感的讨论。

sentences.en: And, of course, it's a cold-blooded murder, right?
sentences.zh: 当然，这是一起冷血谋杀，对吧？

sentences.en: And yet it's also become this referendum, it would seem, on a broken healthcare system and populist rage over that.
sentences.zh: 然而它似乎也成了一场对破碎的医疗系统以及由此引发的民粹主义愤怒的全民公决。

sentences.en: So how are you kind of making sense of all of that as this case now moves into this next phase of the actual criminal justice system?
sentences.zh: 随着案件进入实际刑事司法系统的下一个阶段，你如何看待这一切？

sentences.en: You know, and I think that's a really interesting question that I've been thinking about myself, because to the police, to prosecutors,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这是一个非常有趣的问题，我自己也在思考，因为对警察、检察官、

sentences.en: to the detectives who've been looking into this and talking to Brian Thompson's family and colleagues and friends, this is a homicide.
sentences.zh: 以及一直在调查此事并与布赖恩·汤普森的家人、同事和朋友交谈的侦探来说，这是一起凶杀案。

sentences.en: This is a murder they have to investigate.
sentences.zh: 这是一起他们必须调查的谋杀案。

sentences.en: This is a murder they have to solve.
sentences.zh: 这是一起他们必须破获的谋杀案。

sentences.en: To many in the public, and even some officers that I've spoken with,
sentences.zh: 但在公众以及我交谈过的一些警官眼中，

sentences.en: it's something that underscores the anger and the frustration at a system that they feel they have no control over, and yet it's such a huge part of their lives, their healthcare,
sentences.zh: 这凸显了人们对一个自认为无法掌控却又在其生活中占据如此巨大分量的体制——医疗保健及其支付方式——的愤怒与挫败感。

sentences.en: and how they pay for it.
sentences.zh: 以及他们是如何支付这笔费用的。

sentences.en: So I wonder, as this case unfolds, will the public's perception of him change as we learn more about what motivated him when he did what he allegedly did,
sentences.zh: 所以我想知道，随着案件的展开，随着我们更多地了解他做出据称行为时的动机——

sentences.en: which is kill a man who was heading to a meeting, a father of two, and a person who is missed by colleagues, is missed by friends, is a human being.
sentences.zh: 也就是杀死一个正要去开会的人、两个孩子的父亲、一个被同事和朋友思念的活生生的人——公众对他的看法会改变吗？

sentences.en: To many, he represents this avaricious industry, but he's also a person who was murdered in cold blood, and his killer, in the minds of the police, in the minds of investigators,
sentences.zh: 在许多人看来，他代表着这个贪婪的行业，但他也是一个被冷血谋杀的人，而在警察、调查人员、

sentences.en: in the minds of prosecutors, and his family and friends, he needs to be brought to justice.
sentences.zh: 检察官以及他的家人和朋友心中，他的凶手必须被绳之以法。

sentences.en: So does this investigation reveal more about him that makes the public think twice about this folk hero status that some have attached to him?
sentences.zh: 那么，这项调查是否会揭示更多关于他的信息，让公众对某些人赋予他的“民间英雄”地位产生三思？

sentences.en: Well, Maria, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，玛丽亚，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此表示感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: After we spoke with Maria, Mangione was charged with five crimes in Pennsylvania, including carrying a gun without a license, forgery,
sentences.zh: 在与玛丽亚交谈后，曼吉奥内在宾夕法尼亚州被控五项罪名，包括无证持枪、伪造文件、

sentences.en: and falsely identifying himself to the authorities.
sentences.zh: 以及向当局提供虚假身份。

sentences.en: A few hours later, prosecutors in Manhattan charged him with murder.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，曼哈顿的检察官对他提出了谋杀指控。

sentences.en: On social media, an ex-account belonging to Mangione gained more than 200,000 followers after his arrest, and the hashtag Free Luigi was trending across the platform.
sentences.zh: 在社交媒体上，一个属于曼吉奥内的前帐号在被捕后获得了超过20万粉丝，话题标签“释放路易吉”在整个平台上成为热门趋势。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: The Times reports that in a major legal defeat, Rupert Murdoch has lost his effort to change his family's trust
sentences.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，在一场重大的法律挫折中，鲁珀特·默多克改变家族信托的努力宣告失败，

sentences.en: in a way that would lock in the right-wing editorial slant of his media empire, which includes Fox News and The Wall Street Journal.
sentences.zh: 该信托原本旨在巩固其媒体帝国（包括福克斯新闻和《华尔街日报》）的右翼社论倾向。

sentences.en: Murdoch, whose family trust originally gave all four of his children equal control of the empire, had sought to rewrite it to give almost all that power to his eldest son, Lachlan,
sentences.zh: 默多克的家族信托原本赋予他的四个孩子对帝国的平等控制权，他曾试图重写该信托，将几乎所有权力交给他最的大儿子拉克兰，

sentences.en: who is far more conservative than his siblings.
sentences.zh: 拉克兰比他的兄弟姐妹保守得多。

sentences.en: But a Nevada court resoundingly rejected that effort, saying that it had been undertaken in bad faith.
sentences.zh: 但内华达州的一家法院断然拒绝了这一努力，称其属于恶意行事。

sentences.en: And in a closely watched trial, Daniel Penney, a former Marine who choked a fellow New York City subway rider last year, was acquitted on a charge of criminally negligent homicide.
sentences.zh: 在一场备受关注的审判中，去年勒死一名纽约地铁乘客的前海军陆战队员丹尼尔·彭尼被判过失杀人罪名不成立。

sentences.en: The case came to exemplify New York City's post-pandemic struggles.
sentences.zh: 这起案件成为了纽约市大流行后困境的典型缩影。

sentences.en: Prosecutors alleged that Penny's actions killed Jordan Neely, who was homeless and had a history of mental illness.
sentences.zh: 检察官指控彭尼的行为导致了乔丹·尼利的死亡，尼利是一名无家可归者，且有精神病史。

sentences.en: Their encounter began after Neely, who is black, began yelling at and frightening fellow subway passengers, prompting Penny, who is white, to put him in a chokehold.
sentences.zh: 他们的冲突始于身为黑人的尼利开始对其他地铁乘客大喊大叫并吓唬他们，这促使身为白人的彭尼对他实施了锁喉。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Stella Tan, Alex Stern, Lindsay Garrison, and Nina Feldman, with help from Luke Vanderpuk.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由斯特拉·谭、亚历克斯·斯特恩、琳赛·加里森和妮娜·费尔德曼制作，卢克·范德普克提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Paige Cowett and Maria Byrne, contains original music by Diane Wong, Alisha B'Etoop, Pat McCusker, and Sophia Landman, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目由佩奇·科维特和玛丽亚·伯恩剪辑，包含黛安·王、阿利莎·贝图普、帕特·麦卡斯克和索菲亚·兰德曼的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德担任音频工程。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsverk of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯韦克创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Nick Pittman.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢尼克·皮特曼。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了群自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱有时甚至令人惊心动魄的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格将带您了解那些试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 都市。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
